what: Closing record of Milestone 4 Phase 1: the evaluation harness and the leakage and integrity tests the frozen protocol requires. Nothing was evaluated on real data.

tests.the_eight_tests_the_protocol_requires: one or more tests each, in tests/test_m4_harness.py (RequiredTests)

not_caught_on_the_first_run_then_given_t: the holdout block is the first block
a log may start without a genesis
the derived-labels map is not checked

tripwires.meaning: Both False: the real inputs support verify, plan and dry-run only. Phase 2 and Phase 4 each turn one on, in a commit of its own.

could_move_a_result: the headline interval is the wider of the two by width (reaction_session on a tie)
regression history mean with no earlier event: ProtocolGap, no default
standardization: population or sample standard deviation (not implemented yet)
a predictor that fails in one fold takes that state for its whole pooled result
the group prior obeys the same maturity and earlier-session rules as the issuer's own history
presentational_or_minor: seeds and random draws per context
40 training events counted with the target defined
unnamed sector divisions are a ProtocolGap
a pooled test below its thresholds makes no predictions
decisions_where_the_protocol_is_silent.owner_action: confirm or amend (a new protocol version, with a record) before Phase 2

not_done_and_not_authorized: Fitting, scoring or evaluating any predictor on any real event, the pooled base rate included
Any read of a holdout outcome
Phase 2 (C2, C3, C4, the logistic and ridge models and their sensitivities), Phase 3 (the C0 baselines), Phase 4 (the holdout look and the report)
Any amendment to the frozen protocol, new data, or a new provider
Declaring Milestone 4 accepted, or starting Milestone 5 or later
not_a_claim: Not a result: nothing was evaluated on real data.
Not evidence that any predictor beats the base rate.
